architecture.note: Documentation matches are lexical and only point to where a concept is discussed.

blind_spots.message: One or more lists are capped for output; the summary reports the true totals. Narrow the target or raise --depth before trusting the list as complete.
External packages were not analyzed; only their local import sites are known.
Test files reachable through dependent modules but not in the selected list. The list is a selection, not the full impact; run these or the suite before trusting it.
Files with parse errors contribute no symbols or edges anywhere in the index.

repo_health.note: Repository-wide counts; they are not scoped to this change.

caveats: This is a static analysis of statically resolvable relationships. Absence of a relationship is not evidence that a change is safe.
Dynamic imports, reflection, runtime dependency injection, generated code and external consumers are not modeled.
Test selection uses import edges and naming conventions, not execution traces; it can miss tests and include irrelevant ones.
Route and database-model detection use framework-specific heuristics and may produce false positives or miss frameworks.
Confidence levels describe extraction certainty, not the risk of the change itself.
